name: A to B
note: Day 3-5 milestone: lift off table A, land on table B (1 m gap). EDIT tables / tags to match the room before flying (cm, origin = centre of table A's top, x toward B, y LEFT, z up). The drone is put on A with its TAIL toward B (heading 180): the takeoff lurch (~30 cm/s backward for ~2 s, notes/drift_battery.md) then goes toward B instead of toward you, and the drone camera looks at tag L next to the laptop (gives the distance the webcam is weak at). It flies to B tail-first.

L.note: tag 1 upright next to the laptop (25 cm left of the webcam, centre 35 cm above A's top), print facing the drone. A bigger matte tag (15 cm) reads better from the air.

B.note: tag 2 upright at B's far edge, centre 25 cm above B's top, print facing A (used when the nose points to B; also lets observe.py --calibrate find the laptop camera pose)
